nead4d8d6d3.headline: GCC growth outlook to remain modest in 2020
nead4d8d6d3.summary: The Gulf Cooperation Council's economic growth outlook for 2020 is expected to remain modest, with oil prices continuing to be the biggest downside risk.
nead4d8d6d3.why: GCC economies are heavily dependent on oil revenues, so fluctuations in oil prices significantly affect their economic growth prospects.

nfdef05cd78.headline: Top 50 corporates reduce debt by about Rs 60,000 cr in first half of FY20
nfdef05cd78.summary: India's top 50 corporates reduced their debt by approximately Rs 60,000 crore in the first half of fiscal year 2020, following a Rs 43,000 crore reduction in the previous year.
nfdef05cd78.why: Corporate deleveraging can improve financial health and creditworthiness, impacting credit markets and investor confidence in India.

n55b6720967.headline: Owners of Three Houses, If You Buy One More Next Year, Acquisition Tax Rate Will Be Up to Four Times Higher
n55b6720967.summary: From next year, households owning three houses in South Korea who buy a fourth will face acquisition tax rates up to four times higher; rates for houses priced between 600 million and 900 million won will also be subdivided and increased.
n55b6720967.why: Higher acquisition taxes aim to curb real estate speculation and cool South Korea's housing market, affecting property investment and prices.
n55b6720967.why_moved: The tax increase is a regulatory measure to cool the housing market by discouraging multiple home ownership.
